notes: Flags: none. The play mat for the rug-free living room (F-66, Andrew 2026-10-25: "something that isn't literally plastic"): two side by side make a 52 x 80" mat on the play floor (living-room e). Cork on natural tree rubber ("Cork + Natural Rubber", Material "Cork, Rubber"), no PVC, TPE or EVA, so plastic-free; wipes clean ("Hand Wash Only"); the rubber grips the floor, so the pair stays put. No plastic-free cork or rubber mat came bigger on Amazon: the 72 x 48" Hatha Yoga and the 72 x 36" HAPBEAR have TPE backs (rejected). Natural rubber smells for a while at first, keep it out of direct sun, and it is latex: skip it if anyone is allergic. Too long for Maddie's 48 x 30" play floor. Color Classic, plain cork; the Mini is 72 x 24 x 4.25mm. Ships from Amazon, sold by Body By Yoga; Prime delivery Tue Oct 27 (2026-10-25). rooms: living-room, from the brief.
